method: startup profile JFR, main-thread execution sampling; phases by stack ancestry; inclusive counts overlap; weights estimate allocation not retained memory; no method-time inference
allocationCounterLimitation: Only one main ThreadAllocationStatistics event at JVM startup; no measured interval delta
processCpuScope: All JVM threads including JIT/GC; launcher OS TID is NOT Java main thread; 100ms RSS samples not exact peak

excludedFirstWeights.reason: exclude initial per-thread weight; may include pre-recording allocations
